objective: Finish the remaining catalogued external provider integrations with verified current endpoint contracts for Perspective and Speak AI.

rulesConsidered: External APIs are replaceable resources, never authorities.
Perspective scores remain advisory safety signals; policy owns thresholds.
Speak AI remains an analysis/transcript provider, not a TTS authority.
Credentials and access/refresh tokens stay outside durable artifacts.

notes: Perspective and Speak AI credentials are server-side only.
Speak AI access and refresh tokens are retained only in process memory.
No external URL fetch surface was introduced beyond fixed provider endpoints.

changes: Added Perspective AnalyzeComment adapter and score normalization.
Added Speak AI API-key/access-token authentication and in-memory refresh flow.
Added Speak AI media status and timestamped transcript reads.
Added deterministic tests and explicit registry/configuration state.
verificationPlan: Require CI and Team Change Gate to pass before merge.
Keep live Perspective/Speak AI qualification separate and credential-gated.
Do not promote either provider to any F06/CAS/F07 authority.
notes: Current official documentation was checked before implementing the endpoint contracts.
No live qualification is claimed by this implementation PR.
